title: T9-T10 segmental ROM inside rib cage specimens at 5 Nm, pooled Ulm database (Wilke 2025)

quantity.name: ROM
quantity.definition: full-range segmental ROM measured optically inside C7-L1 rib cage specimens loaded with +/-5 Nm; median only (white circles in Fig 3)

source.authors: Wilke HJ, et al. (Ulm in vitro database)
source.sample: pooled Ulm database: T9-T10 segments inside C7-L1 specimens with entire rib cage (FE/LB n=23, AR n=26 per level)
source.sex: 176 F / 110 M (as printed for rib cage pool, Table 1)

protocol.summary: Pooled Ulm polysegmental C7-L1 specimens with entire rib cage, pure moments +/-5 Nm, 1 deg/s, 3.5 cycles; segmental motion by optical tracking.
how_to_simulate: Model C7-L1 with entire rib cage, fix L1, load C7 with +/-5 Nm pure moments, no preload
Report full-range T9-T10 rotation at peak moment
protocol.notes: POOLED: Liebsch 2018 and Liebsch 2019 are the same 8 specimens yet both listed in Table 3 (possible double counting inside this pool); also includes Liebsch 2020 and Liebsch 2020 FB intact data. Do not pool with those studies.

extraction.uncertainty: +/-0.1 deg (ring centre from white interior, 300 dpi)
extraction.check_notes: Ring centres verified visually for LB T1-T2 (4.95) and LB T7-T8 (~1.9).

pass_rule.rule: model within [min,max] of specimens (median as target)

ribcage.intact_structures: entire rib cage (sternum, costal cartilage, ribs, intercostal muscles in most source studies)

pooled_from.study: Liebsch 2020c Front Bioeng (Liebsch 2020 FB, intact state)
